documentation: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Every coefficient below is a transparent placeholder chosen for this demonstration; none is a measured or validated fire spread rate.
Replace spread-forecast.js assess() with a validated model (for example Rothermel) without changing the map or dashboard code.
Head distance = baseSpreadMPerHr x horizon x windFactor x slopeFactor x fuelFactor x humidityFactor x sizeFactor.
sizeRamp keeps a new ignition from spreading as far as an established fire, and lets large fires spread somewhat faster (log growth up to maxFactor).
Gusts, measured fuel model and hourly Dixie weather are not in the data package; wind, humidity and fuel are scenario assumptions and are labeled as such.
Roads are reported as a possible slowing factor only; a road never stops the modeled spread.
